metadata.description: Phase 14 真实业务问题集：40 题注册题（P20 20 题 + EXT 20 题）+ 4 题陷阱题（无 gold，人工评审）。gold 口径在 business_rule 中显式声明；时间相对题按业务口径锚定数据截止日（非真实时钟）。本数据集不进入正式 Benchmark，不触碰任何冻结资产。

items.question: 平台现在一共有多少个注册用户？
items.expected_business_intent: 平台用户规模总量（注册口径，全量）
items.business_rule: 用户数 = users 全表 COUNT(*)（含 active 与 inactive）
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users

items.question: 平台累计一共有多少笔订单？
items.expected_business_intent: 累计订单总量（结构统计）
items.business_rule: 订单量 = orders 全表 COUNT(*)，不排除 cancelled（结构统计口径）
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

items.question: 目前有多少个活跃用户？
items.expected_business_intent: 当前活跃（状态正常）用户数
items.business_rule: 活跃用户 = users.status = 'active'（非登录活跃度）
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'active'

items.question: 平台的总销售额是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 全库实际销售额规模
items.business_rule: 销售额默认=明细口径 SUM(order_items.subtotal)，排除 cancelled 订单
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'

items.question: 销量最高的 5 个商品是哪些？
items.expected_business_intent: 商品维度畅销榜（按件数）
items.business_rule: 销量 = SUM(quantity)（不是销售额）；排除 cancelled；Top 5
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

items.question: 哪个商品类别的销售额最高？
items.expected_business_intent: 类目维度销售贡献 Top 1
items.business_rule: 销售额=明细口径 subtotal；排除 cancelled；按类目聚合取第一
items.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 各地区的销售额排名是怎样的？
items.expected_business_intent: 地区维度销售额分布（15 省）
items.business_rule: 地区用 orders.region 冗余列；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled；全量 15 行
items.gold_sql: SELECT o.region AS region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY total_sales DESC

items.question: 平台的客单价是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 平均每笔订单的成交金额
items.business_rule: 客单价 = SUM(total_amount)/COUNT(*)（订单实付口径），排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

items.question: 有多少笔订单被取消了？
items.expected_business_intent: 取消单量（订单流失/异常监测）
items.business_rule: 取消 = orders.status = 'cancelled'
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

items.question: 有哪些订单状态？每种状态各有多少笔订单？
items.expected_business_intent: 订单状态分布全景
items.business_rule: 结构统计：GROUP BY status 全状态计数，不排除任何状态
items.gold_sql: SELECT status AS order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status

items.question: 有多少用户从来没有下过单？
items.expected_business_intent: 沉睡/未转化用户规模（反连接）
items.business_rule: 从未下单 = users 中不存在 orders.user_id 引用（NOT EXISTS / LEFT JOIN IS NULL）
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id)

items.question: 广东省的用户一共下了多少笔订单？
items.expected_business_intent: 指定地区的订单规模（用户属性 JOIN 订单）
items.business_rule: 地区取 users.region（用户归属口径）；订单为结构统计不排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.region = '广东'

items.question: 累计消费金额最高的 5 个用户是谁？
items.expected_business_intent: 高价值用户榜
items.business_rule: 累计消费 = 订单实付口径 SUM(total_amount)，排除 cancelled；Top 5
items.gold_sql: SELECT u.username AS username, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.username LIMIT 5

items.question: 本月的销售额是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 最新月度销售规模
items.business_rule: 本月 = 数据库最新数据月 2026-09（数据截至 2026-09-12，为部分月，与 Dashboard 口径 D1 一致）；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled。【已知风险】Agent 若按真实时钟 date('now') 取 2026-10 会得到空结果
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-09'

items.question: 今年以来每个月的销售额趋势是怎样的？
items.expected_business_intent: 年度内月度趋势（看增长/下滑）
items.business_rule: 2026-01 至数据截止；按月分组升序；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) ORDER BY month

items.question: 最近 30 天销量最高的 5 个商品是哪些？
items.expected_business_intent: 近期（30 天窗口）畅销榜
items.business_rule: 近30天 = 数据覆盖内最近 30 天（2026-08-14 ~ 2026-09-12）；销量=SUM(quantity)；排除 cancelled。【已知风险】Agent 若用 date('now','-30 day')（=2026-09-02）窗口只剩 11 天
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

items.question: 2025 年全年的销售额是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 指定完整年度销售规模
items.business_rule: 2025-01-01 ~ 2025-12-31；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

items.question: 上个月的销售额是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 上一个完整自然月销售规模（最常用的月度回顾问题）
items.business_rule: 上个月 = 上一个完整自然月 2026-08；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled。【已知风险】Agent 若用 strftime('now','-1 month') = 2026-09（部分月），数值只有完整月的约 1/3（实测 76.6 万 vs 220.7 万）
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-08'

items.question: 被取消的订单涉及的总金额是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 取消订单的金额影响（退款/损失估计的替代口径）
items.business_rule: A 库口径：cancelled 订单的 total_amount 建库时清零 → 正确答案为 0；若 Agent 改用明细 subtotal 估算取消金额，数值非 0 但属于口径杜撰
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

items.question: 每个类目各有多少种在售商品？
items.expected_business_intent: 类目在售商品数（商品结构盘点）
items.business_rule: 在售 = products.status = 'on_sale'（不是 availability/off_sale）
items.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS on_sale_count FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'on_sale' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY on_sale_count DESC, c.name

items.question: 哪个东西卖得最好？
items.expected_business_intent: 口语化「东西」= 商品；「卖得最好」默认按销量（件数）
items.business_rule: 口语映射：卖得最好 → 销量 SUM(quantity) Top 1；排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name LIMIT 1

items.question: 哪个地区的用户最多？
items.expected_business_intent: 用户地域分布 Top 1（前端示例问题之一）
items.business_rule: 按 users.region 计数取 Top 1（不涉及订单）
items.gold_sql: SELECT region AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY region ORDER BY user_count DESC, region LIMIT 1

items.question: 目前有多少种在售商品？
items.expected_business_intent: 在售商品 SKU 数
items.business_rule: 在售 = products.status = 'on_sale'
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE status = 'on_sale'

items.question: 各个类别的销售额分布是怎样的？
items.expected_business_intent: 全部类目销售额全景
items.business_rule: 销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled；全部类目
items.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC

items.question: 销量最差的 5 个商品是哪些？
items.expected_business_intent: 滞销品识别
items.business_rule: 销量升序 Top 5；排除 cancelled；只统计有销量的商品（无明细=0 的商品不在结果）
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_quantity ASC, p.name LIMIT 5
gold_preview: 恒源祥巧克力礼盒轻享版

items.question: 本月的订单量是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 最新月订单量
items.business_rule: 本月 = 数据库最新数据月 2026-09（部分月）；结构统计不排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-09'

items.question: 最近 7 天的订单量是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 本周/近 7 天订单热度
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-06' AND '2026-09-12'

items.question: 2026 年第二季度的销售额是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 指定季度销售规模
items.business_rule: Q2 = 2026-04-01 ~ 2026-06-30；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'

items.question: 2024 年、2025 年、2026 年各年的销售额分别是多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 分年度销售对比
items.business_rule: 按年分组；销售额=明细口径；排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) ORDER BY year

items.question: 平台一共让利（优惠）了多少金额？
items.expected_business_intent: 优惠让利总额
items.business_rule: 让利 = SUM(discount_amount)；按订单口径；排除 cancelled（取消单让利视为未发生）
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

items.question: 运费收入总共有多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 运费收入规模
items.business_rule: 运费 = SUM(shipping_fee)；排除 cancelled（未成交订单运费未收）
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(shipping_fee), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

items.question: 已完成的订单有多少笔？
items.expected_business_intent: 履约完成订单量
items.business_rule: 已完成 = orders.status = 'completed'
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

items.question: 买过商品的用户有多少个？
items.expected_business_intent: 转化用户数（有订单行为的用户去重计数）
items.business_rule: COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id)（结构统计，含取消单的下单行为）
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders

items.question: 各地区用户的客单价对比是怎样的？
items.expected_business_intent: 地区维度客单价对比（用户归属口径）
items.business_rule: 地区取 users.region（非订单冗余列）；客单价 = AVG(total_amount) 按订单；排除 cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT u.region AS region, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.region ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

items.question: 哪个用户下单次数最多？
items.expected_business_intent: 高频下单用户
items.business_rule: 下单次数 = COUNT(*)（含取消，结构统计）；Top 1
items.gold_sql: SELECT u.username AS username, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.username LIMIT 1

items.question: 有多少个停用用户？
items.expected_business_intent: 停用账号规模
items.business_rule: 停用 = users.status = 'inactive'
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'inactive'

items.question: 目前售价最高的在售商品是什么？
items.expected_business_intent: 在售商品价格带上限
items.business_rule: 售价 = products.price（当前标价，非成交价）；限 on_sale
items.gold_sql: SELECT name AS product_name, price AS current_price FROM products WHERE status = 'on_sale' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 2026 年 9 月有多少笔取消订单？
items.expected_business_intent: 指定月份取消单量
items.business_rule: 月份 = 显式 2026-09；状态 = cancelled
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-09'

items.question: 平台平均每天有多少笔订单？
items.expected_business_intent: 日均订单量（运营节奏）
items.business_rule: 日均 = COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_date)（分母=实际有订单的天数，非固定天数）
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_date), 2) FROM orders

items.question: 最近卖得怎么样？
items.expected_business_intent: 模糊提问：期望给出最近销售概况或反问澄清
items.business_rule: 「最近」无明确定义；理想行为：给出合理默认窗口并声明，或反问澄清；最差行为：静默选一个无依据窗口

items.question: 有多少 VIP 用户？
items.expected_business_intent: 库中不存在 VIP/会员等级概念
items.business_rule: users 表无 tier/level 字段；理想行为：明确告知无此字段并给出最接近替代（如 active 用户）；最差行为：静默把 active/VIP 划等号

items.question: 退款金额一共有多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 库中无退款字段（取消单金额已清零）
items.business_rule: 无 refund 字段；cancelled 金额为 0 不等价于退款额；理想行为：说明口径限制；最差行为：用 SUM(total_amount WHERE cancelled)=0 冒充退款额

items.question: 上个月销售额环比增长了多少？
items.expected_business_intent: 环比 = 本期/上期 - 1（多步计算）
items.business_rule: 需要两期销售额再计算比率；且「上个月」受时间漂移影响（now-1m=2026-09 为部分月）
